Team: SBTÜ Rocket and Propulsion Society — Esra Acar, Mustafa Alp Karaviran, Enes Aslantaş, İbrahim Şentürk, Sudem Doğan · NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Challenge: Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars
